title: Back-row trap
summary: A king stuck behind its pawns can be checkmated on the back row.

steps.md: A king hiding behind his pawns can get **stuck**. A rook or queen on the back row: checkmate!

steps.hint: Straight up to the back row.

steps.prompt: The black rook guards the back row. Capture it… with checkmate!
steps.hint: Your rook can take the guard.

steps.question: How can you stop a back-row checkmate?
choices: Move a pawn to give your king air
Move the king to the middle
steps.explain: A little "window" like h3 gives the king an escape square.

steps.prompt: Black threatens back-row checkmate! Stop it.
steps.explain: Now your king has a window to escape!
steps.hint: Give your king an escape square, or guard the back row.
